opinion.headline: The geopolitics of AI: Why WAICO matters
opinion.hook: China's formation of the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization marks a pivotal moment in the global AI landscape, marking the likely beginning of new alignments among nations.
opinion.summary: Developing countries might lean towards China's affordable open-source AI frameworks, finding them more attractive than their Western counterparts. This could intensify the race for AI supremacy, putting India in a challenging position to reconcile its economic aspirations with the necessity for strategic self-reliance.

opinion.headline: Expressed universe
opinion.hook: Matter is understood as a varying form of energy, essential for inertness.
opinion.summary: The static principle binds subtle energies into tangible forms and lines. This static influence of Prakriti brings abstract concepts into the initial stage of matter. The sentient principle's influence is effulgent and expressive, expanding subtly. The perceived universe is the collectivity of objects bound by forms and symbolizations.
